name: add_affiliation
description: Add a group/organization affiliation to a character. Use this when a character belongs to, leads, or founded a group. This is for organizations like 'Kyoshi Warriors', 'Air Acolytes', 'Team Avatar' - NOT for relationships between individual characters. Returns the character's current affiliations so you can see what's already recorded and avoid duplicates.

character_name.description: Name of the character to add affiliation to (must already exist in knowledge base)

group.description: Name of the organization/group (e.g., 'Kyoshi Warriors', 'Air Acolytes', 'White Lotus', 'Team Avatar')

role.description: Optional role in the group (e.g., 'Leader', 'Founder', 'Member', 'Former Member', 'Co-founder')

evidence_url.description: URL of the wiki page with evidence of this affiliation

evidence_text.description: Quote from the page supporting this affiliation
